## Rule

LIVE rule is `boundary-pair-lines`.

For each non-background color, if it has exactly four input cells and at least
one pair spans the active grid boundary, paint the spanning row and/or column
with that color. A horizontal pair is same row at left/right valid columns; a
vertical pair is same column at top/bottom valid rows. The rest of the active
output is background, and padded cells outside the output rectangle stay all
zero in the full tensor.

## Algorithm sketch

Reference lives in `Task_by_Task/task161/prototypes/task161_numpy_reference.py`
and the live-derived notes are in `Task_by_Task/task161/LIVE_ALGORITHM.md`.
Current safe rewrite must match the LIVE tensor behavior, not just visible
decoded grids.

## Cost analysis

Baseline cost is 117,897 (memory 117,817, params 80). The main waste was
materializing full `[1,9,20,25]` boundary-hit masks before reducing them back
to row/column projections, plus carrying an F16 output tail.

The current staged rewrite reduces cost to 9,516 (memory 9,435, params 81) by:
- deriving valid rows/cols with tiny full-input reductions rather than 10-channel
  top-row/left-column FLOAT strips;
- converting boundary cells into scalar color labels with `ArgMax`;
- using dynamic `Slice` plus explicit static `value_info` for right/bottom
  boundaries so unused rows/columns are not materialized;
- carrying the output as a single UINT8 label plane with sentinel 10 outside
  the active rectangle;
- replacing the full `line_any` materialization with two broadcasted `Where`
  nodes keyed by row-any and column-any vectors;
- exposing the final `Equal(label, channel_ids)` as the named BOOL `output`.

Expected raw log gain is about 2.5168; calibrated structural-LIVE expectation
recorded in the staged manifest is about +1.2081 LB.

## Don't-do log

- Do not ship the old organic "best extent/pairing" variants: task history
  shows task161 organic was hidden-bad (-12.80 LB).
- Do not apply slice-before-cast blindly here. It verifies, but cost increases
  from 117,897 to 129,909 because the raw input slice is FLOAT.
- Do not replace this structural LIVE task with identity/cherry13b. Prompt
  calibration says task161 likely contributes positive LIVE LB.
- Do not fall back to the older 37,528 or 12,118 variants unless the dynamic
  Slice/static-value-info candidate is rejected by an external reviewer; the
  sub-10k graph passed local score, LIVE verification, and synthetic gating.
